subject: trophy room
fact: Only a few mangy pelts, stuffed heads, and shattered antlers remain.
source_quote: The first door to Sequoia’s left opens into a trophy room. Only a few mangy pelts, stuffed heads, and shattered antlers remain.

subject: domicile of the majordomo
fact: Zephyr sighs; it’s stripped of anything valuable.
source_quote: The next door on the southern wall opens into the domicile of the majordomo of the castle. Zephyr sighs; it’s stripped of anything valuable.

subject: westernmost hallway end
fact: Much like the other parts of the castle, this room is partially collapsed.
source_quote: From there, Zephyr opens the westernmost door, where the hallway ends. Much like the other parts of the castle, this room is partially collapsed.

subject: barracks room
fact: The remains of cots and plain wooden chests convince the rogue that this was once a barracks room for castle guards—undoubtedly the human sort.
source_quote: The remains of cots and plain wooden chests convince the rogue that this was once a barracks room for castle guards—undoubtedly the human sort.

subject: intact chest
fact: Zephyr notices an intact chest at the south end of the room.
source_quote: Zephyr notices an intact chest at the south end of the room.

subject: giant lizard
fact: The lizard was using the chest as a lure. This time, the poor creature died.
source_quote: As he approaches it, he notices a giant lizard just in time. The lizard was using the chest as a lure. This time, the poor creature died.

subject: stairway room
fact: Sequoia leads the group past the last door in the hallway and into a room with a stairway leading down.
source_quote: Sequoia leads the group past the last door in the hallway and into a room with a stairway leading down.

subject: swarm of rats
fact: It also has a swarm of rats. Rats that are quickly killed.
source_quote: It also has a swarm of rats. Rats that are quickly killed.

subject: finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse
fact: I suggest we finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse. Don’t want any nasty surprises to follow us.
source_quote: Calmer turns to the group, “I suggest we finish exploring the ruins of the moathouse. Don’t want any nasty surprises to follow us.”

subject: wrecked great hall
fact: They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors.
source_quote: They cross the wrecked great hall and head down the southern passageway, which is 70 feet long and has three doors.

subject: old conference room
fact: The first door the rogue opens reveals an old conference room chamber. He sniffs and shuts the door, “Nothing to be found.”
source_quote: The first door the rogue opens reveals an old conference room chamber. He sniffs and shuts the door, “Nothing to be found.”

subject: door number two
fact: And for door number two,” as he opens the next door on the western wall.
source_quote: Sequoia mutters, “And for door number two,” as he opens the next door on the western wall.

subject: bed chamber for lowly official
fact: And in this chamber, he finds what must have been a bed chamber for some lowly official.
source_quote: And in this chamber, he finds what must have been a bed chamber for some lowly official.

subject: another door across hallway
fact: Across the hallway, he sees another door and excitedly opens it. He looks inside, and although the room is in shambles and things are missing, whatever remains still appears valuable.
source_quote: Across the hallway, he sees another door and excitedly opens it. He looks inside, and although the room is in shambles and things are missing, whatever remains still appears valuable.

subject: treasures
fact: He enters carefully, and as he picks up the treasures, he realizes they are worthless.
source_quote: He enters carefully, and as he picks up the treasures, he realizes they are worthless.

subject: salon for meetings
fact: He looks around and mutters, “A salon for meetings?”
source_quote: He looks around and mutters, “A salon for meetings?”

subject: large chamber at end of hallway
fact: Leaving the salon and reentering the hallway, he walks into the large chamber at the end of the hallway. Much like other parts of the moathouse, this room is empty of anything valuable. Unlike other rooms, this room has a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike. It fails.
source_quote: Leaving the salon and reentering the hallway, he walks into the large chamber at the end of the hallway. Much like other parts of the moathouse, this room is empty of anything valuable. Unlike other rooms, this room has a giant poisonous snake that attempts to strike. It fails.

subject: giant poisonous snake
fact: Soon, like the other nuisance monsters the group has faced, it is dead.
source_quote: Soon, like the other nuisance monsters the group has faced, it is dead.
